## Executive Summary
Fixed a bug where `RetentionManager.__init__()` was reading the wrong key (`github_release_days`) instead of the correct key (`github_releases_days`) from web_settings. This caused the retention manager to always use the default value of 14 days instead of reading the configured database value.
